name: NIST SP 800-53 Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
note: Mapping by JSolve B.V.: which tests evidence a control is JSolve's assessment, not the publisher's. A control with tests is fully assessed only when they check everything about it that Azure configuration can show. Controls that do not concern the Azure environment (people, physical security, organization-wide governance, end-user devices, software development) are not applicable; the other controls without a test need evidence outside configuration. Every control and control enhancement of release 5.2.0 (NIST's OSCAL catalog) except the withdrawn ones; titles are NIST's (public domain).
